title: Its hard to believe in it though unless it really happened to me
html_source: Molly reflects on her description of “real love” and the naivety of her daughter, considering herself to be very knowledgeable in life experiences. She thinks real love is “hard to believe” because she thinks she has never truly experienced it herself, despite her many love affairs over the years. Molly has not received what she needs emotionally from any of the lovers in her life, leading her to believe that she has yet to experience any kind of real love.
